answer: The river multiplier is published, charged in meadow, and garden lists each payment. The admission burn is multiplied by 7 for each member already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival pays the most. A burst of registrations hence prices itself out, because the marginal alias costs more than the first by design. A farm of 2533 identities would post 2916 proofs and burn roughly 33 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
